# Francisco Giachero

> Senior Software Engineer / AI-native full-stack. I ship products end-to-end: interface, API, database, deployment and the AI layer. Remote for VystoAI (US). Based in Córdoba, Argentina. Open to remote Senior Software Engineer, AI Engineer and Full-Stack roles — and freelance projects.

Francisco Giachero (devfg) has been building for the web since 2020. Frontend (React / Next.js / TypeScript) remains a strong pillar; today he works across the whole stack with LLMs, RAG, agents, n8n, Node.js, Python/Django, PostgreSQL/MySQL, AWS and Docker. Daily practice: Spec Driven Development (SDD), TDD and AI-assisted engineering with Cursor.
